svg.title: Seerist and OSINT evidence-grounded memo workflow
svg.desc: Canonical version 2.5 evidence-grounded memo workflow showing one memo-level intent gate, bounded Seerist and OSINT collection, policy admission with human exception triage, provider-neutral source assurance, external claim synthesis, optional organizational context, deterministic quality verification, and a human publication gate with sampled audit. Governance remains outside the per-memo loop.
svg.text: Version 2.5 | Human effort per memo: intent, publication, pushed exceptions, and governance
One intent gate before collection; code admits under policy and pushes exceptions
Request | scope | org relevance | questions | IRs
One memo-level approval; no collection before it.
Discovery -> one gap-fill pass -> one lead-resolution hop
Persist raw response before parsing; enforce call, time, item, and page budgets.
Detect changing totals, duplicate IDs, timestamp inversions, and incomplete pages.
Endpoint + source type + content depth + lineage determine role.
One source hop | lossless document | stable hash anchors
Code validates lineage and exact anchors; AI has no approval authority.
Relevant + ready + valid anchors -> code admits
Partial | uncertain | bounded failure -> pushed exception.
Geopolitical profile: two elicitations, code-owned reconciliation, single-source assessment, typed note
Approved evidence snapshot + canonical source + approved IRs
Complete content | stable hash anchors | provenance | permitted claim kinds | limitations
IRs proposed by AI, approved at the panel 1 question gate; panel 2 cannot add or widen an IR
Bottom-up from the source | chunking A
Typed: actor | action | event type | date
Blind to Extract | same observation schema
Same typing and claim kind as Extract
Goal: dispose every observation from both passes against the canonical source
Code: anchor resolves at hash | merge needs anchor overlap + same claim kind; IR tags inherited
Code: schema valid | IR tags are approved IDs | untouched spans queued as residual
Bounded semantic check: one scoped call per observation, no memory across calls
Does the anchored span support the observation? yes | no. Residual span relevant? yes | no
Verdict: accepted | merged | rejected | unresolved; unresolved becomes a caveat, never dropped
Commit reconciled observation set for Assess
Goal: characterize the source, not the world
Reliability: access, track record, alignment and interest (state media, funders, audience)
Dependency: original vs relayed; a wire relayed by many outlets is one source
Per-IR coverage (assigns IR-untagged observations; no fit = out-of-IR) | limitations
Excluded: information credibility, alternatives, confidence; those are cross-source judgments for panel 3
Prepare -> Act -> Observe -> Check; commit source assessment for Write
Goal: typed source note, canonical JSON first; prose is rendered from it
Every statement carries observation IDs and IR IDs; no free text without lineage
Code check: no statement without lineage | every accepted observation and IR disposition placed
Semantic check: no statement exceeds its observations; a claim kind never upgrades in prose
Commit only when both checks pass
Typed observations | IR dispositions | source assessment | caveats | gaps | anchor lineage
Out-of-IR observations are kept and routed to the question gate as proposed IRs, never dropped
Single-source only: corroboration, confidence and indicators are assigned in panel 3
Frozen goal + exit conditions -> scoped call -> observation -> retry or commit
Exit conditions must be satisfiable by an honest negative: silent and contradicted are valid variants
Retry = fresh context + deterministic failure reason only | immutable attempts | bounded failure
Model never chooses the transition | ship Extract first; add Sweep only if measured misses justify it
External facts first; Vestas context and memo standards remain separate authorities
Per-IR eligibility | Challenge aliases | KJ1-KJ8 | policy cap 3 | omissions | gaps
Old memos set standard, never facts
External claim + governed context -> exposure and consequence pathways
Every implication needs dual lineage; unknown remains an explicit gap.
Claim-level citations | dual-lineage implications | standard version | limitations | gaps
Fidelity | citations | independence | calibration | alternatives | relevance
No weighted score: one blocking authority failure blocks publication review.
Maximum two revision cycles; unresolved findings escalate.
Lineage drill-down | sampled audit (N from policy)
Only a human can publish; calibration is recorded.
Explicit authorities, typed artifacts, deterministic transitions, and incremental delivery
Model output proposes artifacts; it never advances state.
Raw inputs and every accepted claim remain traceable.
Unsupported claim | bad citation | hidden dependency
No context-only corroboration or historical-fact leakage.
No confidence inflation or suppressed contradiction.
Human effort is per memo, never per source.
Everything else is machine work or a named interim stand-in.
